name: codeflow-monorepo
description: Local-first execution intelligence and visualization for Node.js and TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:cli-assets
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/session packages/parser packages/core packages/instrumentation integrations/node integrations/playwright packages/recorder packages/analyzer packages/exporters packages/cli
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && CODEFLOW_RUN_NETWORK_TESTS=1 npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:production && npm run pack:check
scripts.demo:record: npm run build && codeflow record --output .codeflow/demo-session.json -- node examples/demo.js
scripts.demo:compare: npm run build && codeflow record --output .codeflow/before.json -- node examples/demo.js && CODEFLOW_DEMO_REGRESSION=1 codeflow record --output .codeflow/after.json -- node examples/demo.js && codeflow compare .codeflow/before.json .codeflow/after.json --threshold 20
